Privacy at DEVVERSE STUDIO

This notice describes the data handled by the current DEVVERSE STUDIO application. Replace the operator and contact information with the responsible legal entity before a commercial launch.

Information used

When you create an account, Supabase Auth processes your email address and authentication data. The workspace stores the display name, timezone and theme you choose, along with the projects, tasks, calendar events, notes and portfolio entries you create. It does not need your password in the application database.

How it is used

This information is used to authenticate you and provide your workspace. The application does not add advertising or third-party analytics. It loads the Supabase client library from esm.sh and typefaces from Google Fonts; those hosts receive ordinary connection data such as your IP address when your browser requests those assets. Supabase operates authentication and database infrastructure for the service; its own terms and privacy notice also apply.

Who can see your content

Projects, tasks, events and notes are restricted to their owner by database row-level security. Portfolio entries are private by default. When you explicitly publish a portfolio entry, its public fields become readable without signing in. If you add a cover image hosted elsewhere, visitors’ browsers request that image from its host. Do not publish information you want to keep private.

Retention and deletion

Workspace records remain until they are deleted or the account is removed by the service operator. The current application does not yet include a self-service account deletion control. Contact the service operator through the channel where this application was provided to request account and data deletion. Backups and security logs may persist for a limited period under the infrastructure provider's retention practices.

Security

The app uses Supabase Auth and row-level security policies for user-owned records. No internet service can promise absolute security. Do not store credentials, financial account details, or other highly sensitive information in notes.

Changes and contact

This notice may need updates as the service changes. Before public commercial use, provide the operator's legal name, a working privacy contact, applicable jurisdiction, and any additional data practices. This draft is not legal advice.
